verdict: Teledyne posted its strongest quarter ever — sales up 9% to $1.68B and GAAP EPS up 25% to $5.82 — as its imaging business surged on demand for infrared detectors for space and drone programs.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: +9.4% vs a year ago — a record quarter

kpis.label: Digital Imaging sales
kpis.note: +15% vs a year ago; its operating income rose 48%

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: $319.5M — cash from operations of $352.5M minus capital spending

segments.name: Digital Imaging
segments.note: Cameras, infrared detectors and imaging systems — sales rose 15.0%, led by infrared detectors for space and unmanned systems, and operating income jumped 48%.

segments.name: Instrumentation
segments.note: Test, measurement and monitoring instruments — sales rose 1.9% to $370.5M.

segments.name: Aerospace and Defense Electronics
segments.note: Electronics for aircraft and defense programs — sales rose 4.3%.

segments.name: Engineered Systems
segments.note: Engineered systems and energy services, largely for government customers — sales rose 7.8%.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative costs — up 8.5%, mainly higher compensation and professional services.

opex.name: R&D
opex.note: Research and development on new sensors, cameras and electronics — down slightly from $83M a year ago.

opex.name: Intangible amortization
opex.note: Non-cash amortization of technology and customer relationships from past acquisitions ($55.2M) — Teledyne excludes it from its non-GAAP earnings.

takeaways.title: Imaging is the growth engine
takeaways.text: Digital Imaging sales rose 15% to $903M — over half of all revenue — on infrared detectors and subsystems for space and unmanned applications, plus growth in industrial vision and healthcare imaging.

takeaways.title: Record profit margin
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 23% to $347M, a 20.6% margin vs 18.4% a year ago, as the higher-margin imaging mix grew fastest. Funded backlog reached nearly $5.3B.

takeaways.title: Cash goes to buybacks and a deal
takeaways.text: Teledyne generated $320M of free cash flow, repurchased $224.6M of stock in September–October, and has a pending ~$1.1B acquisition of Varex Imaging.

oneTimers: $55M of acquired intangible asset amortization — a non-cash cost of past acquisitions that Teledyne excludes from its non-GAAP earnings of $6.72 per share.
footerNote: Teledyne reports to one decimal place ($1,684.9M of sales); figures here are rounded to whole $M and still balance exactly. Net other income rounds to $0M: it is $10.5M of net interest expense, plus $2.6M of retirement benefit income and $7.5M of other income (including a mark-to-market gain on Varex shares). Net income of $273M is the $272.8M attributable to Teledyne (noncontrolling interest was $0 this quarter).
